proposed_frozen_protocol.correctness: compare the fixed cached and uncached workload logits before accepting timing
proposed_frozen_protocol.timing: synchronize the CUDA stream immediately before and after every timed decode sequence
proposed_frozen_protocol.warmup: blocks of five repetitions, at most six blocks, accept the first two adjacent blocks satisfying <=2% median drift and <=5% CV
proposed_frozen_protocol.measurement: three passes of ten repetitions, with raw repetitions and per-pass diagnostics persisted
proposed_frozen_protocol.acceptance: all three measured passes must satisfy the same <=5% within-pass CV rule; otherwise return measurement-unstable
proposed_frozen_protocol.scalar: median cached-decode tokens/second over all 30 measured repetitions only after correctness and stability pass
proposed_frozen_protocol.memory: persist peak allocated CUDA bytes, peak reserved CUDA bytes, and exact live KV-cache bytes; Pareto uses allocated bytes
proposed_frozen_protocol.candidate_tuning: none; workload, thresholds, repetition counts, and protocol are global constants
